scope: Offline-only reusable routing primitives for the Strict-R3 long ablation funnel. No inference bundle, scoring producer, calibration, policy, portfolio, exchange, or live-execution path was modified.

implementation.target_free_contract: The new helpers consume only candidate identity, decision timestamp, and already-produced scores. They have no outcome, policy-label, or held-window percentile input.
implementation.route_contract: Top fraction is calculated independently at each decision timestamp, using ceil(n*fraction) and candidate_id ascending as the deterministic final tie-breaker.
implementation.percentile_contract: Timestamp percentiles are local to the current cross section and never normalize over a held month or period.

validation_evidence.result: 6 focused tests passed; routing is deterministic, timestamp-local, and preserves the existing strict-R3 baseline score formula.
